english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an edge, a location or relative side, a family side, or an informal group taking one side.

examples.english: This time, we are on the home team's side.
examples.traditional: 今次比賽我哋企喺主隊嗰邊。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 kei5 hai2 zyu2 deoi6 go2 bin1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a concrete boundary or outer edge, such as the edge of a table.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an edge or rim around an object.
Use 邊 for the physical outer edge of an object or area, rather than a political boundary.

examples.english: There’s a scratch on the edge of the table.
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 toi4 go3 bin1 jau5 tiu4 gwaat3 han4

examples.english: The rim of the cup is chipped.
examples.jyutping: go3 bui1 bin1 bang1 zo2 jat1 gok3

examples.english: The border of the table is sharp, so be careful.
examples.traditional: 張枱個邊好利㗎，小心啲。
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 go3 bin1 hou2 lei6 gaa3 siu2 sam1 di1
